japanese.pronunciation: Standard Kana with Tokyo pitch accent type in brackets [0], [1]... obeying mora count constraint
japanese.rules: Use simple sentence structure and equivalent N5-N4 vocabulary. In sentences, only use basic kanji without complex furigana.

fields.Expression: Target word/expression in kanji or kana
fields.Reading: Kana reading with pitch accent bracket [0], [1]...
fields.Kanji: Kanji writing if applicable, else empty
fields.Type: Part of speech (e.g. Noun, Verb-u, Verb-ru, Na-adj)

french.pronunciation: International Phonetic Alphabet (IPA) enclosed in slashes, e.g. /flɑ.ne/
french.rules: Use simple A0-A1 grammar and vocabulary, basic present tense. Always include definite/indefinite article (le/la, un/une) for nouns in Expression.

fields.Expression: French word with article (e.g. 'le livre' or 'flâner')
fields.Type: Part of speech and gender (e.g. 'Nom (m)', 'Verbe (1er gr)')
